name: emendator
description: Analyze and fix Minecraft modpack conflicts: graded mixin detection, headless Docker boots, crash bisection, and a precise reversible fix ladder.

tools.name: scan_instance
tools.description: Scan a modpack: mods + graded conflict map

tools.name: run_test
tools.description: Boot the set headless in Docker and classify

tools.name: bisect
tools.description: Delta-debug a crash to the guilty subset

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Full persisted verdict of one run

tools.name: plan_mixin_fixes
tools.description: Plan the precise mixin fix ladder

tools.name: verify_mixin_fixes
tools.description: Re-boot and diff vs the baseline run

tools.name: update_mod
tools.description: Swap a jar to its latest build (gated)

tools.name: rollback_mod
tools.description: Swap a jar to the previous release (gated)
